earlier_attempts.detail: The linker returned success but debug stripping ran out of disk and left a 160-byte binary. Retired task-owned build artifacts were removed, the CLI was rebuilt, and the executable was checked before testing.
A first test launch preceded restoration of the native-module link required for pytest collection. Collection was rerun after the module was available.

The standalone server could not import PySpark and used Spark 3.5 config defaults. createDataFrame failed before schema validation because spark.sql.session.localRelationSizeLimit was missing. Setting the server Python environment to the pinned 4.2.1 installation fixed the gate; assertions and production code were unchanged.
